credit_line: Gift of Peter S. Lynch in memory of Carolyn A. Lynch
description: The oval-shaped top of a tree fills the center of the image. The tree has black branches and red foliage. A conifer with black foliage peeks out from behind the red tree. Tall mountains in shades of brown and gray rise in the background. A sliver of white sky is visible above the landscape.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
